summary.text: Alexis Rodriguez is the Democratic nominee challenging incumbent Andrew Lanza in NY State Senate District 24. According to BallotReady and Branch, she is originally from Staten Island, worked at Standard & Poor's, and has been a New York City public elementary school educator since 2013; this is her first run for public office.

paragraphs.text: According to Branch, originally from Staten Island; this is her first run for public office.

According to BallotReady, graduated from St. John Villa Academy (2006), earned a bachelor's degree in economics from St. John's University (2009) and a master's degree in childhood education (mathematics) from Brooklyn College (2015).
According to BallotReady, worked at Standard & Poor's from 2007 to 2012 and has been an elementary school educator with the New York City Department of Education since 2013.
Ballotpedia lists her as the Democratic candidate for the November 3, 2026 general election; the June 23 Democratic primary was canceled.
